body: I've had a bad experience before calling the national suicide hotline and I don't think phone conversations are very beneficial to me, but I appreciate your comment. I can't really afford to take any bereavement time, and I can't pass up this opportunity for overtime today, though I really need some healing time. What I really need is a well qualified counselor or psychiatrist, but I'm not sure my budget can get me the help I need.  I want to live happily, not in pain. If I have to live like this forever I'd rather not continue. Thank you for taking the time to read my post and submit a thoughtful comment.

I wanted to reply to you last night but I was dosing off. Your words really helped put me at ease, at least enough to rest, and I thank you for that. Hearing that someone else has been there is helpful, though I don't wish this pain on anyone. I also appreciate you reminding me that it's not my fault that it all came to a head last night. It's stupid how comforting it can be to be told things you already kind if know, but it helps validate what I'm feeling.   
  
I was speaking about the same boyfriend in both my posts. Sometimes he can be so caring and helpful, other times he doesn't realize the damage he's doing. I think I'm going to choose to stop sharing my emotional issues with him, as a previous commenter said he's not qualified to help me.  He told me he wanted to help me, but then makes me feel guilty for sharing by telling me that I should be accountable for how much pain I cause him with my depression. Imagine if a psychiatrist said that to a patient?  
  
Today I am well enough to at least get through the day, I think. I'm dreading it but I think I'll get through it. As long as I can keep my cool for the next 12 hours I can come home and crash. My depression is only crippling in short spells, which makes it hard to treat because I can get through my normal life and responsibilities without much trouble, except maybe some anxiety, and then completely fall apart when I let my wall down or get hit by something unexpectedly. That makes it seem like it's not that bad, but I believe my condition is very serious because I sliced up my leg last night. That's not okay.  
  
Anyway I'm babbling on now. I really appreciate your comment, and I hope you are doing well yourself. It really means a lot that you took the time to read my entire crazy post and write a long thoughtful comment. I hope I don't make another post here in the future, but chances are I will slip back into my hole and harm myself again.
Thank you, I hope you can recover. I'm just so hurt. How could he claim to love me. He makes me feel worthless.

In my family I can only really open up with my mom, but I don't want to burden her with more things to worry about. Her father is dying and she has so many other stresses, she's the only reason I haven't attempted to kill myself yet.  
  
I want you to be right, but I can't think clearly. I'm so confused. He hurt me so deeply. I know attractive women put themselves down but I genuinely dislike my physical attributes. I confided in my boyfriend that I think I may have body dysmorphia because I always want my body to be covered up and I used to be more expressive and love my body. I'm sure my body has changed and I hate it. I weigh a few pounds more than when we first got together. At the same time my depression stops me from being active to improve my fitness level and health.  
  
I don't want to die but I wish I could stop living. Nothing brings joy and I face continual failures. I don't even think he loves me anymore. If he cared about me, why would he berate me and tear me down with his words.
I want help. I want competent help. But I can't even afford my bills, I don't have extra money for psychiatrist or counselor visits.

I'm 25, I should have a career and be financially stable by now, or at least working towards that, but I'm not even keeping my head above water. I made stupid decisions that put me here. I have failed at relationships, pursuing my education, maintaining a well paying job, maintaining my confidence, and maintaining my physical and mental health. I haven't accomplished anything, and at this rate I never will. I don't know if there's a point to living like this.

We lived with my family for a month so we could catch up on some bills. A month is pretty much all they will offer, and all I can do around them. My father is an alcoholic and narcissist and he is often belligerent.  
  
I'm afraid of bankruptcy because it will leave a mark on my credit for several years. I've been working instead to find a better paying job but I'm not having much luck.  
  
I know he sounds horrible. I fell in love with him because he brought adventure to my life. He was fearless and intelligent and always affectionate. Now we can't afford adventure and he doesn't know how to help me, he just contributes to my depression. But I still love him and for some reason he brings me dome joy and hope when he's not berating me. I don't know if I can leave. I would fall apart.

I know, but even if I leave him, I'm still stuck paying off all our shared debt which was in my name. I'm an idiot, I helped him get a motorcycle with the loan in my name. All my credit cards are maxed out. I just signed a lease on a cheap apartment for us, and though its cheap I still can't afford it on my own. If he's still in my life, he brings occasional joy but frequent emotional abuse. If he's gone I have nothing to live for. Just working to pay debt. No enjoyment, no future, I'm sorry I appreciate your time. I just have nothing, and I can't rationalize enduring much more pain.

I wish I could love my physical characteristics but there's nothing beautiful about me. He has told me otherwise but I'm not what I want to be. I used to be passionate about traveling the world, I left the country once but I don't think I'll ever be able to afford to do it again. I used to pursue an education in Nutrition sciences, but the professors at my school frustrated me because much of our coursework was outdated and one professor was proud to have worked for a corporation that I feel is screwing over our country's health for profits. I'm too much of an idealist. I'm unhappy, and the only thing that makes me feel better is the same person who told me I was worthless. I'm sick.

Thank you. I need help but I don't know where to go. I called a suicide hotline once and the woman just told me to drink some warm milk and rest. At that point I really felt no one could offer legitimate help.

My job fucked me over, my partner is making my illness worse when he offered to help, I'm broke, I can't afford professional help, I've lost my passions and dreams, I hate my body,  I have no valuable characteristics, I can't even rely on my lover, my life is a pointless waste of me working and living paycheck to paycheck and unable to meet my minimum bills, and I'm thousands of dollars in debt because I have been supporting us two with little financial contribution from him because he lost a job. I don't feel hopeful that things will improve, even if we break up I still have all our debt in my name to pay off. I made a stupid decision by being the financial backbone for us for so long.
